A [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as a '''bartender''' at an [[Unidentified bar (Dubrava)|establishment]] in the [[Canal District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]]. He was at work when a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Attack on a Dubravan bar|assailed]] the bar and [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of those inside in their efforts to locate [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] recruiter [[Jal Te Gniev]].
